longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm] (featured); Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards] (featured); Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards] (featured); The Thing [Ben Grimm] (featured)]; Mole Man [Harvey Elder] (villain); Franklin Richards (supporting); Tintin; The Ruined [B'arr; Exalt; Stem] (villains, intro); Moloids (villains); Yvette Diamonde [Martyr] (intro, villain); Laurent Levesseur (intro, possessed); Herve Dubois (intro, possessed); Aaron Starr; Arlise (intro); Yancy Street Gang (in Paris!)
longest_story.first_line: Somewhere... near the very core of the Earth...
longest_story.keywords: acquiring superpowers; alternate dimensions; France; Paris; returns of heroes; underground adventures; Western Europe
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited); Comicraft (credited); Albert Deschesne (credited as AD)
longest_story.notes:
The events in this story follow the Fantastic Four's return from the Pocket Universe in Heroes Reborn: The Return #1-4. The Ruined appear next in issue #20.

Giganto was previously seen in The Sensational Spider-Man #13 (February 1997). He would return in Fantastic Four #1/2 (March 1998).
longest_story.synopsis: In Paris, Yvette Diamonde protests construction over a historic site. Several people are possessed by ancient beings called The Ruined. The Fantastic Four sets things right. Yvette finds that she has permanently acquired new powers -- just like the Fantastic Four once did.
longest_story.title: Vive la Fantastique!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards; Billie (Wilhemina) Lumpkin (intro); Iconoclast (villain, intro); Red Ghost's Super-Apes (villains); Spider-Man; Joe (intro); Cathy Polombo (intro)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft
longest_story.notes: First appearance of the Fantastic Four's new headquarters on Manhattan's Pier Four.
longest_story.synopsis: Since Four Freedoms Plaza has been destroyed, the FF move in to their warehouse on Pier Four. Johnny searches for Lyja in vain. As the FF get settled in their new home, they are attacked by Iconoclast, a villain only Sue can see.
longest_story.title: Be It Ever So Humble...

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards; Red Ghost (villain); Red Ghost's Super-Apes (villain); Crucible (villain, introduction); Silver Surfer; Alicia Masters; Mole Man; Herbie; Cathy Polombo; Devin Chapman (introduction); Isabel Aguirre (introduction); Gordon Clay (introduction)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft
longest_story.notes: Cameo appearance by Iconoclast. Crucible's true identity is revealed in issue #12.
longest_story.synopsis: Reed does research on Iconoclast. Reed battles the Red Ghost's Super-Apes. The Silver Surfer and the Mole Man sense danger. Two reporters investigate the monastery where Doctor Doom once sought refuge, only to find the monks have all been killed by Crucible.
longest_story.title: Happy New Year, Reed Richards . . . Now Die!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Silver Surfer; Alicia Masters; Mole Man; Franklin Richards (cameo); Billie Lumpkin (cameo); Terminus (villain); Crucible (villain); Isobel Aguirre (cameo); Gordon Clay (cameo); Moloids (cameo); Yancy Street Gang (cameo)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft
longest_story.notes: First issue of the lengthy run by Chris Claremont, Salvador Larroca, and Art Thibert (all the way to issue #32). First post-Heroes Reborn meeting of Thing and Alicia Masters.
longest_story.synopsis: The Silver Surfer and Alicia seek help from the FF. They all go to Yorktown, Saskatchewan, and join forces with the Mole Man in battle against Terminus. Ben gives Alicia and the Surfer his blessing. Meanwhile, Crucible threatens the imprisoned reporters.
longest_story.title: The Enemy Within

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards] (origin); Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards (cameo); Alyssa Moy (intro, origin, cameo); Crucible (villain); Isabel Aguirre (cameo); Gordon Clay (cameo); Genoshan Freedom Brigade (cameo); Warwolves (behind the scenes, cameo)
longest_story.letters: Albert Deschesne (credited as AD); Comicraft; Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes: The Crucible storyline is resolved in issues #10-12. The concern over the warping and twisting of the fabric of reality comes to a head in issues #24-25.
longest_story.synopsis: Reed and Ben head for Stockholm to attend an international symposium of physicists, with Reed's friend Alyssa Moy. Crucible attacks. Reed notices a resemblance between Crucible and Doctor Doom. Crucible steals Reed's rationality and mental talents for himself.
longest_story.title: Broken Reed

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mister Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards; Alyssa Moy; Iron Fist [Danny Rand]; Misty Knight; Power Man [Luke Cage]; She-Hulk [Jennifer Walters]; Namor, the Sub-Mariner; Wasp [Janet Van Dyne]; Colleen Wing; Gatecrasher; Technet [Bodybag; China Doll; Ferro 2; Joyboy; Numbers; Ringtoss; Scatterbrain; Thug; Yap]; Kay Cera; Warwolves (behind the scenes)
longest_story.letters: Comicraft; Albert Deschesne (credited as AD); Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes:
Part 1 of 3.
First appearance of the new Pogo Plane.
longest_story.synopsis: Sue trains with Iron Fist and has a reunion with Namor. Reed takes Franklin to a baseball game, and takes Sue out to dinner. Alyssa worries about Reed. The Technet arrives with a warrant for Franklin's extradition to the Prime Continuum.
longest_story.title: April is the Cruelest Month

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards (cameo); Alyssa Moy (cameo); Doctor Strange; Phoenix [Jean Grey]; Roma; Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Watcher; Gatecrasher (villain); Technet [Bodybag; China Doll; Ferro 2; Joyboy; Numbers; Ringtoss; Scatterbrain; Thug; Waxworks; Yap] (villain); Warwolves (villain); Captain Britain Corps (villain); the Bacchae (introduction, cameo)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft
longest_story.notes: Part 2 of 3. The Bacchae appear next in issue #20. Sue's heart's desire is revealed to be Warrior-Queen of Atlantis, Consort of Namor (see issue #32)!
longest_story.synopsis: Alyssa and Franklin run from the Technet and the Warwolves, running into the Bacchae in the process. The Fantastic Four come to the rescue. Sue's heart's desire is revealed. The Fantastic Four are transported to the Prime Continuum and face the entire Captain Britain Corps.
longest_story.title: Seize the Child!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards; Alyssa Moy; Opal Luna Saturnyne (guest-star); Roma (guest-star); Eternity (guest-star); Galactus (guest-star); Infinity (guest-star); Captain Britain Corps (villains); Technet (villains) [Gatecrasher; Bodybag; China Doll; Joyboy; Numbers; Ringtoss; Scatterbrain; Thug; Waxworks; Yap]
longest_story.letters: Comicraft; Dave Lanphear (credited as DL); Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes: Part 3 of 3.
longest_story.synopsis: As the Fantastic Four battle the Captain Britain Corps, Johnny tries to figure out what's going on from Gatecrasher, then breaks into the Starlight Citadel and makes a deal with Opal Luna Saturnyne and Roma, allowing Franklin to stay with the Fantastic Four.
longest_story.title: Storm Warnings

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Caledonia [Alysande Stuart] (origin) (cameo) (introduction); Kay Cera (cameo); Neal Conan (cameo); Kraven the Hunter [Alexei Kravinoff]; Stan Lee; Alyssa Moy (cameo); Puppy (cameo) (introduction); Franklin Richards (cameo); Spider-Man [Peter Parker]; Manoli Wetherell (cameo); Guladkin
longest_story.letters: Comicraft (credited); Albert Deschesne (credited as AD); Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes: First appearance of Caledonia, an alternate universe counterpart of Alysande Stuart (see Excalibur #6-22), and Puppy, Franklin's pet, who bears a striking resemblance to Lockjaw. For Neal and Manoli, see Uncanny X-Men #226-227 and Sovereign Seven #10-12.
longest_story.synopsis: Neal Conan and Manoli Wetherell, from NPR-TV, interview the Fantastic Four. Johnny, Caledonia (a former slave Johnny rescued in the Core Continuum), Spider-Man, and Kraven the Hunter hunt for a creature in Four Freedoms Plaza, and find a puppy for Franklin.
longest_story.title: A Day in the Life

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Press Gang [Hawkshaw (villain); Pipeline [Cormick Grimshaw] (villain); Punchout (villain); Jennifer Ransome (villain)]; Annihilus (cameo); Blastaar (cameo); Caledonia [Alysande Stuart] (cameo); Alyssa Moy (cameo); Puppy (cameo); Franklin Richards (cameo); Roma; Opal Luna Saturnyne; Terrax [Tyros] (cameo); Trapster [Peter Petruski] (villain)
longest_story.letters: Comicraft (credited); Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes: Part 1 of 3. First real introduction to the innards of the FF's headquarters on Pier Four. The field of distortion and instability in the starscape is the chaos storm, which arrives at earth in issue #24.
longest_story.synopsis: Reed's mind is clearly not up to par, but his fighting skills and his passion are well above normal. Johnny gets to know Caledonia better. The Press Gang (from Genosha) attacks Reed, and with the Trapster's help succeeds in capturing him.
longest_story.title: Reed Richards: Alone!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards; Alyssa Moy; Caledonia; Detective Charlotte Jones; Crucible (villain); Ayesha [Her] (villain); Val Cooper (guest-star); Manoli Wetherell; Jomo Kimane; Farisa Mansour; Harry Soong
longest_story.letters: Comicraft; Dave Lanphear (credited as DL); Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes: Part 2 of 3. The Fantastic Four's origin is retold (and modernized!) in this issue. Mr. Fantastic appears only in that flashback.
longest_story.synopsis: Sue, Ben, and Johnny investigate Reed's disappearance. They follow him to Genosha, where they are attacked by Ayesha, captured by Crucible, and body-switched with other people. Johnny's body-switcher ignites his nova flame, which destroys the citadel.
longest_story.title: The First -- The Final? -- Fire!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards; Alyssa Moy; Caledonia; Crucible; Ayesha [Her]; Enclave [Maris Morlak; Wladyslav Shinski]; Hackshaw; Val Cooper; Chief Magistrate Anderson; Tam; Jomo Kimane; Farisa Mansour; Harry Soong
longest_story.letters: Comicraft; Albert Deschesne (credited as AD); Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes: Part 3 of 3. Crucible's identity is revealed as Maris Morlak and/or Wladyslav Shinski. Morlak is killed; Shinski/Crucible, Ayesha, and C. M. Anderson are transported to another dimension. For the data provided by Alyssa Moy, see issues #5 and #24.
longest_story.synopsis: Sue, Ben, and Johnny reunite with Reed and join forces with C. M. Anderson against Crucible and the Enclave. Sue, Ben, and Johnny get their rightful bodies back. Reed confronts Crucible and gets his genius back. The Fantastic Four evict Crucible and company from Genosha.
longest_story.title: Once More, O Green & Pleasant Land

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards (cameo); Billie Lumpkin (cameo); Caledonia (cameo); Detective Charlotte Jones (cameo); Ronan the Accuser (villain); three Kree (villain); Firestar; Vision; Mr. Bermudez (cameo)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft; Albert Deschesne (credited as AD)
longest_story.notes: Part 1 of 3. The three Kree are the survivors of an assault on earth, from the Avengers story "Live Kree or Die". This story is a sequel to the original Ronan story, from FF (vol. 1) #64-65. The supporting cast does not appear again until issue #20.
longest_story.synopsis: The FF, Franklin, and Caledonia all dream that Ronan killed the FF. Atop the Four Freedoms Plaza, federal authorities prepare to return three Kree prisoners home. Ronan attacks and transports the FF, the Kree, Detective Jones, and even the Plaza to the moon.
longest_story.title: I, Ronan

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Detective Charlotte Jones (cameo); Bounty (introduction, cameo); Ronan (villain); three Kree (villain)
longest_story.letters: Comicraft; Richard Starkings (credited as RS); Emerson Miranda (credited as EM)
longest_story.notes: Part 2 of 3. Charlotte Jones' X-Men uniform was given to her in Uncanny X-Men #264. She visited the moon previously in X-Factor #65-68 (not X-Factor #18). Bounty appears next in issue #20. Part of the battle takes place inside Four Freedoms Plaza.
longest_story.synopsis: The Fantastic Four fight Ronan on the moon. Ronan infects Sue with a Mannequin, which binds her to his will. Reed, Ben, and Johnny defeat the three Kree warriors. Ronan and Sue head for the home of the Watcher. Meanwhile, Bounty is hired to retrieve Caledonia.
longest_story.title: The Moon is a Lonely Place to Die Hard!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mister Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Caledonia [Alysande Stuart]; Valeria von Doom (Earth-99315); Iron Man [Tony Stark]; Charlotte Jones; Pepper Potts; Ronan the Accuser; Callie Yaeger; Alicia Masters (future); Invisible Woman (future); Franklin Richards (future)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited); Albert Deschesne of Comicraft (credited as Comicraft's Albert Deschesne)
longest_story.notes: Part 3 of 3. The story concludes in Iron Man (vol. 3) #14. Sue remains in Mannequin's shape until issue #18. Valeria appears next in issue #20. Dr. Doom joins the FF (sort of!) in issue #26. Sue becomes the Baroness von Doom in issue #27.
longest_story.synopsis: SHIELD monitors the battle on the moon and calls Iron Man to help. His armor malfunctions and he battles Reed, Ben, and Johnny. Reed, Ben, and Johnny catch a glimpse of a future in which they died, Sue married Dr. Doom, and they had a daughter, Valeria.
longest_story.title: A Clash of Iron

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Margali Szardos; Kree Avengers [Captain America; Giant-Man; Iron Man; Scarlet Witch]; Brood; Destiny; Legion; Acanti; Lucas (introduction); Redwing (introduction)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft; Albert Deschesne
longest_story.notes: The Fantastic Four appear here following Iron Man (vol. 3) #14, where Ronan escapes with the Watcher's weapon, and Iron Man and Charlotte Jones return to earth.
longest_story.synopsis: Margali Szardos transports the unknowing Fantastic Four into a future where Dr. Doom joined the Fantastic Four and Sue married him, and where the Kree and Brood have enslaved the earth. The Fantastic Four battle the Kree Avengers and team up with Lucas and Redwing to defeat the Brood.
longest_story.title: Unnatural Selection

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Twisted Sisters [Coil (introduction); Gyre (introduction); Helix (introduction); Ringlet (introduction)]; Lockdown (guest) (introduction); Rosetta Stone (guest) (introduction)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited); Comicraft (credited)
longest_story.notes: Part 1 of 2. Lockdown and Rosetta Stone's true names are revealed in the next issue.
longest_story.synopsis: The Fantastic Four arrive back to their right time, but in the Negative Zone. They are captured and placed in a virtual reality scenario where they lead criminal lives, constantly thwarted by Lockdown and Rosetta Stone. Reed comes up with a dangerous escape plan.
longest_story.title: Shadow City's Most Wanted!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards] (briefly as Torque)]; Alyssa Moy (flashback); Lockdown [Jomo Kimanye] (guest-star); Rosetta Stone [Nefer Neith Sinue] (guest-star); Twisted Sisters [Coil; Gyre; Helix; Ringlet]; Dr. Edwina Dantes (introduction); Prince Bayan (introduction)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft
longest_story.notes: Part 2 of 2. Lockdown and Rosetta Stone's true names are revealed. They both appear next in Contest of Champions II #3. Ringlet is incorrectly called Ringtoss. Sue frees herself from the Mannequin. The Twisted Sisters appear next in X-Men #105.
longest_story.synopsis: Lockdown and Rosetta Stone imprison the Fantastic Four. Reed breaks them out. Sue frees herself from the virtual reality scenario and from Mannequin's shape, then frees the others. They consider taking action against the scenario and flee before they are recaptured.
longest_story.title: Bedlam Breakout

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Annihilus (villain); Bureau of Monsters Management; Crystal Spiders
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft
longest_story.notes: The Fantastic Four finally return to earth at the end of this issue (they have been away from it since issue #13).
longest_story.synopsis: The Fantastic Four arrive on Annihilus' throneworld. Reed searches for hardware that Annihilus stole from Four Freedoms Plaza, while Ben, Sue, and Johnny battle Annihilus. Their combined skills bring them home, to learn that Paris has been overtaken by the Ruined.
longest_story.title: Down & Out in the Negative Zone

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mister Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Bounty; Caledonia [Alysande Stuart] (Earth-9809); Marvel Girl [Valeria Richards] (Earth-99315); Alyssa Moy; Puppy; Reno (introduction); Franklin Richards; Valeria Richards; Alysande Stuart; Margali Szardos; Ruined [B'arr (villain); Exalt (villain); Katar (villain, introduction); Stem (villain)]; Bacchae (villain); Yvette Diamonde; Arlisse
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited); Albert Deschesne of Comicraft (credited as Comicraft's Albert Deschesne)
longest_story.notes: The Ruined last appeared in issue #1. The Bacchae appear here following their cameo in Fantastic Four (Marvel, 1998 series) #7. Margali appears here between Fantastic Four (Marvel, 1998 series) #16 and Fantastic Four 1999 (Marvel, 1999 series). Valeria von Doom (Marvel Girl) appears here for the first time in the mainstream universe, after a cameo in Fantastic Four (Marvel, 1998 series) #15.
longest_story.synopsis: The Fantastic Four rescue Margali Szardos from the Ruined. At Pier Four, a teenage girl suddenly appears. Franklin recognizes her as Valeria, remembering her from his special dreams. Bounty arrives to arrest Caledonia. The Bacchae show up to take vengeance on the Fantastic Four.
longest_story.title: Since the Last Time We Saw Paris -- Itza Been Ruined!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Bounty; Caledonia [Alysande Stuart]; Cerberus (villain); Hades (villain); Hera (villain); Hercules; Hippolyta (villain); Marvel Girl [Valeria Richards]; Alyssa Moy; Persephone (guest); Puppy; Reno; Bacchae (villain); Centaurs; Myrmidons; Titans
longest_story.letters: Comicraft (credited); Richard Starkings (credited as RS)
longest_story.notes: The Fantastic Four are reunited with Franklin and friends, for the first time since issue #13. Puppy teleports for the first time in this issue. The Fantastic Four appear next in Contest of Champions II #1-5.
longest_story.synopsis: Franklin, Valeria, Caledonia, Bounty, Alyssa, and Puppy battle the Bacchae, Hippolyta, Hades, and Cerberus. Valeria runs afoul of Hera. The Fantastic Four and Hercules come to the rescue, aided by Persephone. Sue meets Valeria, who calls her "Mom."
longest_story.title: Rascals 4

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Absorbing Man [Crusher Creel] (villain); Annihilus (cameo); Bounty; Doctor Doom [Victor Von Doom] (cameo); Marvel Girl [Valeria Richards]; Ronan the Accuser (cameo); She-Hulk [Jennifer Walters] (guest); Spider-Man [Peter Parker] (guest); Titania [Mary MacPherran] (villain); The Ruined (cameo); Badoon (cameo); Brood (cameo)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited as RS); Comicraft (credited)
longest_story.notes: Part 1 of 2. The Fantastic Four appear here after Contest of Champions II (hence the reference to Badoon and Brood). Sue finds the birth certificate to her stillborn daughter (from Fantastic Four vol. 1 #267), Valerie Meghan Richards. Valeria is Sue and Doctor Doom's daughter.
longest_story.synopsis: Reed investigates Valeria's claim to be Sue's daughter. Sue vents her anger and Valeria overhears. They both reflect on their past. Valeria battles the Absorbing Man and Titania, who drug She-Hulk and Ben. Sue trounces the villains, and brings Valeria home.
longest_story.title: Lost Hope!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Franklin Richards; Alysande Stuart [Caledonia]; Puppy; Marvel Girl [Valeria von Doom]; The Avengers [Captain America [Steve Rogers] (guest-star); Firestar (guest-star); Justice (guest-star); Scarlet Witch (guest-star); Thor (guest-star); Wonder Man (guest-star)]; Red Skull (villain); Mad Thinker (villain); Awesome Android; Namorita (guest-star); She-Hulk (guest-star); Matt Murdock; Jeryn Hogarth; Chris Claremont (guest-star); Salvador Larroca (guest-star); Art Thibert (guest-star)
longest_story.keywords: Helicarrier; mind control; San Diego Comic Con
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited as RS); Comicraft
longest_story.notes: Part 2 of 2. This story was published shortly after the 1999 San Diego Comic Con. The Fantastic Four appear next in the Fantastic Four 2000 Annual. First appearance of Valeria's room, which suddenly appears in the Fantastic Four's headquarters out of nowhere.
longest_story.synopsis: Valeria makes herself at home in Reed's lab. The Fantastic Four trace the villains to the San Diego Comic Convention. The Avengers (under influence) attack them. The real villains are the Red Skull and the Mad Thinker, who escape with SHIELD's Helicarrier.
longest_story.title: Skull Session

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Captain America [Steve Rogers] (guest); Hydro-Man [Morrie Bench]; Iron Man [Tony Stark] (guest); Billie Lumpkin; Marvel Girl [Valeria Richards]; Professor X [Charles Xavier] (guest); Razorback [Buford Hollis] (villain); Franklin Richards; Scarlet Witch [Wanda Maximoff] (guest); Caledonia; Puppy; Bounty; Yancy Street Gang
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited as RS); Comicraft (credited)
longest_story.notes: Part 1 of the "Return of Dr. Doom" epic (of 8 parts). The earth of the Pocket Universe arrives in our universe (see Heroes Reborn: Doomsday, Heroes Reborn: Ashema, and Heroes Reborn: Doom). Franklin, Puppy, and Caledonia appear next in Fantastic Four 2000.
longest_story.synopsis: The Fantastic Four prepare for the arrival of the chaos storm. Valeria vows to protect Franklin. The Fantastic Four and friends enjoy a fabulous feast. The chaos storm arrives early. Sue sends Franklin, Caledonia, and Puppy to safety. A massive tidal wave looms over Manhattan.
longest_story.title: Last Farewell

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; Invisible Woman [Susan Storm Richards]; Mr. Fantastic [Reed Richards]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]]; Ashema; Divinity (villain); Doctor Doom [Victor Von Doom]; Queen Dorma (villain); Dreaming Celestial (villain); Lancer [Samantha Dunbar]; Marvel Girl [Valeria Richards] (cameo); Shakti (villain); Technarx (villain)
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings (credited); Comicraft (credited)
longest_story.notes: Part 2 of the "Return of Dr. Doom" epic (of 8 parts). Doctor Doom, Ashema, Lancer, the Dreaming Celestial, Divinity, Dorma, Shakti, and Technarx all appear here immediately after Heroes Reborn: Doom, in which they return from the Pocket Universe.
longest_story.synopsis: The tidal wave hits Manhattan. Doctor Doom's ship appears. Time stops. The Fantastic Four and Valeria enter the ship and battle Doom's army. They join forces to battle the Dreaming Celestial and rescue Ashema. Only Reed and Doom remain standing -- and then only Doom.
longest_story.title: When Worlds Collide!

longest_story.characters: Fantastic Four [Doctor Doom [Mr. Fantastic, Reed Richards]; Human Torch [Johnny Storm]; The Thing [Ben Grimm]; Invisible Woman [Sue Storm Richards]]; Marvel Girl [Valeria von Doom] (cameo); Wyatt Wingfoot (cameo); Wynona Wingfoot (cameo); Lancer; Divinity (villain); Dorma (villain); Shakti (villain); Technarx (villain); The Avengers [Captain America [Steve Rogers]; Iron Man [Tony Stark] Scarlet Witch]; Ashema
longest_story.letters: Richard Starkings; Comicraft
longest_story.notes: Part 3 of the "Return of Doctor Doom" epic (of 8 parts). Mr. Fantastic poses as Doctor Doom from this issue until issue #31. The real Doctor Doom appears next in issue #30.
longest_story.synopsis: Valeria hugs Doctor Doom (her "Daddy"). Sue realizes that the man in Doom's armor is her husband. They send Valeria to Haven. "Doom" demands an alliance between his army and the Fantastic Four. Dorma insists that it be sealed by the wedding of Doom and Sue.
longest_story.title: I Am Doctor Doom!

longest_story.characters: The Avengers [Captain America [Steve Rogers]; Firestar [Angelica Jones]; Iron Man [Tony Stark]; Justice [Vance Astrovik]; Scarlet Witch [Wanda Maximoff]; Wonder Man [Simon Williams]]; Black Panther [T'Challa]; Black Widow [Natasha Romanoff]; Chris Claremont (cameo); President Bill Clinton (cameo); Neal Conan (cameo); Valerie Cooper; Daredevil [Matt Murdock]; Divinity (Counter-Earth (Heroes Reborn)) (villain); Dorma (Counter-Earth (Heroes Reborn)) (villain); Bob Edwards (cameo); Nick Fury; J. longest_story.notes: Part 4 of the "Return of Dr. Doom" epic (of 8 parts). Sue becomes the Baroness von Doom in this issue, a title she will keep forever. The necklace that Namor gives Sue plays a major role in issue #32.
longest_story.synopsis: The world reacts to the news that Sue is going to marry Doctor Doom. Reed tries in vain to free himself from Doom's armor. The Avengers confront Ben about the situation. Namor gives Sue a necklace. Sue marries Doom, and becomes the Baroness von Doom.

The villains are captured. The Avengers begin to suspect the truth. Reed sends Lancer to find the real Doctor Doom.

longest_story.synopsis: The Frightful Four attack Wyatt Wingfoot's tribe and the Fantastic Four come to the rescue. Sharon Ventura tries to come to grips with what has been done to her. Sue sees Reed change security protocols and put on Doom's mask by choice. She vows to save her husband.

longest_story.synopsis: The Fantastic Four travel to Latveria, where Doom and his bride are greeted with acclamation. Sue tries to get used to her new role as Baroness von Doom. Doom contacts Sue, asking her to build a teleport link. Sue struggles with her loyalties, and brings Doom home.

longest_story.notes: Part 8 of the "Return of Doctor Doom" epic (of 8 parts). Reed returns to his right mind and body. The Fantastic Four appear next in Fantastic Four 2000, which serves as an epilogue to this epic.
longest_story.synopsis: Doom and Reed battle. Doom and Sue disappear. Ben and Johnny find them and learn that Reed is being controlled by Doom's armor. Doom defeats Reed, and reclaims his armor, thus freeing Reed from its control. Doom and the Fantastic Four bid farewell.
longest_story.title: Doomsday!

longest_story.notes: The Fantastic Four appear here following Fantastic Four 2000. Dedicated to Stan Lee and Jack Kirby. Chris Claremont's last issue. Sue's necklace appears here following its introduction in issue #27. The Namor/Sue sub-plot (see issue #7) comes to a resolution.
longest_story.synopsis: Sue takes a boat out into the mid-Pacific, where she is attacked. Her necklace allows her to breathe underwater and brings Namor to her aid. They are attacked by Dorma. The Fantastic Four come to the rescue. Sue and Reed affirm their love for each other.
